entries.en: belt with which the garment is girded; clothing sash (cinto for the vestido)

entries.zh: 韜带（护套之带——「韜」谓刀剑套、箭袋一类遮护套，以带系佩）
entries.en: strap or belt of a sheath or case (cover for sword or bow); band for slinging a scabbard
entries.notes: M 栏首字录 Zo 而附 [疑:To] 校记，依 R 栏对音 tǒw 与汉字「韜」之套义定读；L 词头承上条句式而截断（vestid）。

entries.en: waist-belt; girdle worn about the waist (that with which one girds oneself)

entries.zh: 松柏（西语 Cipres 本指柏树，汉栏以松柏并举之常青树当之）
entries.en: cypress; glossed with the evergreen pine-and-cypress pair

entries.zh: 遍（周匝、环绕一周；次义「一次、一遍」）
entries.en: circuit; compass, ambit; a round or passage all around

entries.zh: 围圈（环绕成圈、围一匝；圈围之界）
entries.en: to encircle, surround in a ring; the circuit or ring drawn about a thing

entries.zh: 头箍（妇人头上所箍之环，缀饰珠宝）
entries.en: head-band or circlet worn by women, set with jewels
to circumcise; to cut off the (fore)skin

entries.zh: 割玉茎皮（割去阳物之皮，即行割礼；原卷作「玉脛皮」，义同婉称）
entries.en: to circumcise, to cut the skin of the member (the foreskin)
entries.notes: 汉栏「玉脛皮」之「脛」当读作「莖」（玉茎，阳物之婉辞），与 circuncidar 四栏互证无碍，故仍判 high。

entries.zh: 冰（坚冰；词头谓「冰之冰凌」一类）
entries.en: ice (Spanish headword 'cirmiones de yelo': de yelo = of ice)
entries.notes: 词头 Cirmiones 拼写罕见（或为冰柱类词之讹），本页两条一致；冰义由 H/M/R 明确互证，词头名词本义未定。

entries.zh: 霜冰（霜凝之冰、结霜的冰凌）
entries.en: frost-ice; hoarfrost and ice (same obscure headword 'cirmiones de yelo')
entries.notes: 词头同上条；霜冰义由 H/M/R 互证。

entries.zh: 枣（枣子；干枣、红枣——本条以中国枣当西语洋李）
entries.en: jujube, Chinese date; paired by the lexicographer with Spanish ciruela (plum/prune)
entries.notes: L ciruela 本义李、梅（马尼拉语境多指李脯、乌梅），而 H/M/R 三栏均明确为枣，两系不合——旧辞书以干枣当洋李干果，故中判。

entries.en: dried jujubes/dates (Spanish headword truncated 'ciruelas para…'; ciruela again paired with the jujube)
entries.notes: L 词头截断（ciruelas para… 无下文，或即 ciruelas pasas 乌梅脯之读），释义依 H/M/R「棗乾」定干枣。

entries.zh: 外科（西语 Cirujano 指外科医师，此以中医「外科」一门当之）
entries.en: surgeon; glossed with the Chinese 'external medicine' branch of healing
